Several sessions (missions with a 20 h wait; 3 days minimum for the Ogre Chef)

A set of seven short missions for the inhabitants of Krailos: the explorer {npc:Larek}, the shaman {npc:Ghorza}, the chief {npc:Vuzrog}, the ogre foreman {npc:Grubokk} and the rebellious goblins of {npc:Nibble}. You get access to the Krailos depot, can trade with the island's NPCs, and receive an {item:Onyx Pendant}, a {item:Shaggy Ogre Bag}, Opals, potions and the achievements **Ogre Chef** and **The Call of the Wild**.
The people of Krailos may be in need of some outside help.
No minimum level, but level 100+ is recommended (dragons, ogres and a {creature:Nightmare} along the way).
{item:Helmet of the Deep|Diving Equipment} for the underwater areas.
For the achievement **The Call of the Wild** you need all **seven** missions completed in the quest log **at the same time**: do {npc:Grubokk}'s mission (ogres) **before** the goblins' mission.
to grind the Golden Quartzes (Larek sells it)
for the Holy Bog Frogs (goblins' mission)
from Vuzrog for each meal (repeatable every 20 h)
10 Great Potions for your vocation (Vuzrog, The Thunder Tusk Clan mission)
Access to the Krailos depot, Skill Trainers and the banker {npc:Kaya}
You can trade with {npc:Ghorza} (potions, runes) and {npc:Mugruu} (weapons, ammo, creature products)
When you hand the amulet to {npc:Larek} (end of the mission **Hungry New World**): use the grate inside his tent.
In the depot room, beneath {npc:Larek}'s tent, after the mission **Hungry New World**.
When you receive the {item:Onyx Pendant} at the end of the mission **The Great Hunger**.
Mugruu's shop (weapons, ammo and creature products)
When you hand the hunting mission **The Thunder Tusk Clan** to {npc:Vuzrog}.
With the {item:Key 0555} (Goblin Bone Key), which you take from the well next to {npc:Grubokk} in the mission **Survival of the Strongest**.

Important order: do **Survival of the Strongest** (Grubokk, ogres) **before** **Revolt of the Goblins** (Nibble). Accepting Grubokk's mission wipes the goblins' one, and talking about missions with ogres and goblins alternately can reset the progress on one of the sides.
When Ghorza talks about the water, use the word {key:water} instead of {key:mission} or {key:quest}.
Always bring the {item:Helmet of the Deep}: you need it in the Water Channel cave (ancient map, Water Elementals and Shark Teeth).
Collect {item:Onyx Chip|Onyx Chips} while you kill ogres: you need 5 for Ghorza.
On the way to the Water Channel you can pick up the {item:Shark Teeth} if you already have the mission The Great Hunger active.
Three small missions for the explorer {npc:Larek}. Reward: access to the Krailos depot.

Krailos is an island on the continent of Oramond. Take the boat in **Edron**, **Darashia**, **Venore** or **Oramond** (Rathleton): talk to the port captain and say {key:hi}, {key:krailos} and {key:yes}. You arrive at the Krailos port, next to {npc:Captain Pelagia} ({coord:33492,31710,6}). Get off the dock and walk **east** across the steppe to **Krailos Village** ({coord:33639,31656,7}), where {npc:Larek} and the other NPCs are.
To leave the island at the end, go back to {npc:Captain Pelagia} and say {key:hi}, the name of the destination (for example {key:venore}) and {key:yes}.
Talk to {npc:Larek} in **Krailos Village**. Say {key:hi}, {key:quest} and {key:yes}. He asks you for a sample of a **Skull Orchid** and gives you a {item:Botanist's Container (Empty)}.

Go to one of the {item:Skull Orchid|Skull Orchids} (there is one at each of the marked spots) and use the {item:Botanist's Container (Empty)} on the flower. You receive the {item:Botanist's Container (Orchid)}.
Hand in the orchid and accept the second mission

Go back to {npc:Larek} and say {key:quest}, {key:yes} (you hand in the orchid) and {key:yes} again to accept the next mission: find a secret room in the ruins to the northwest, reachable only through water.

Equip the {item:Helmet of the Deep}. Go to the beach in the **northwest** of Krailos, enter the water and swim until you reach a small island. Enter the {item:Water Channel} at the marked spot and follow the path.
You will meet {creature:Shark|Sharks}, {creature:Jellyfish} and {creature:Water Elemental|Water Elementals}. Keep the diving gear on so you do not take drown damage.

At the end of the path use the {item:Rope} to climb up to a room with a {creature:Nightmare}. Use the {item:Sarcophagus (Quest)} in the **northwest** corner of the room to receive the {item:Ancient Map}.

To leave the secret room, go back down the hole you climbed up with the rope and return along the underwater path to the small island and the northwest beach (keep the {item:Helmet of the Deep} on until you are out of the water).
The {creature:Nightmare} is dangerous for low levels. Kill it or sneak past carefully.
Hand in the map and accept the third mission

Go back to {npc:Larek} and say {key:quest}, {key:yes} (you hand in the map) and {key:yes} again. He tells you that a steppe bird stole an ancient amulet from him and took it to its nest, somewhere to the **south**.

Walk **south** from the village until you find a {item:Dead Tree} with a {item:Bird Nest}. Use the nest to take out the {item:Ancient Amulet (Quest)} (*"You see something glittering between the eggs and pull an ancient amulet out of the bird nest."*).

Go back to {npc:Larek}, say {key:quest} and {key:yes}. As a reward you can use the {item:Grille|grille} inside his tent: down there is a **depot**, **Skill Trainers** and the NPC {npc:Kaya} (banker and mail).
Access to the Krailos depot (grille in Larek's tent), Skill Trainers and Kaya.

You can only start this mission if the salt lake north of {npc:Ghorza}'s tent is **dry**. If it is full, wait a few days until it dries up again. In this mission always use the word {key:water} (not {key:mission} or {key:quest}).
Talk to {npc:Ghorza}, in the northern part of Krailos Village. Say {key:hi}, {key:water} and {key:yes}. She gives you a {item:Carafe of Water Binding}.
Fill the carafe with Water Elementals

Equip the {item:Helmet of the Deep} and go to the underwater area in the **northwest** of Krailos. Kill {creature:Water Elemental|Water Elementals} and use the {item:Carafe of Water Binding} on their corpses until the carafe is full (**5** corpses). Between each full carafe, leave the water the same way (small island and northwest beach) and return to the lake.
Underwater area of the Water Elementals

Go to the dry salt lake, a few steps **northeast** of Ghorza, and use the full carafe on a {item:Salt-Incrusted Floor (Purple)|purple salt floor}. It only works on **purple** salt: yellow and orange salt absorbs the souls too quickly.
Repeat the previous two steps until you have emptied the carafe **6 times** in total (30 Water Elementals). The lake fills up with {item:Dirty Water}.
The server save erases the progress: you have to do all 6 deliveries on the same day, otherwise you start over from scratch.
Go back to {npc:Ghorza} and say {key:water}. She keeps the carafe and says the water is still poisonous: she asks you to ask {npc:Larek} how to purify it.

Do the next mission right after this one. If you stop here, the lake dries up again and you have to repeat Catching Spirits; in that case there are reports that you finish the mission but **do not receive the reward**.

Talk to {npc:Larek} and say {key:water}. He explains that you have to grind **Golden Quartzes** into powder and scatter it in the water. If you do not have a {item:Hoe}, buy one from him ({key:trade}).

Look for {item:Golden Quartzes} across the steppe around Krailos Village: they have an **orange tone with a golden shine** and are often half-buried in the sand. Use the {item:Hoe} on each one to get {item:Golden Quartz Powder} (*"You are grinding the golden quartzes into a fine powder."*). You need **30** portions.

Go to the lake and **use** (do not drop) the 30 portions of powder in the middle of the lake. Each use gives the message *"You sprinkle the golden dust into the toxic water and it glitters softly."*. The {item:Dirty Water} turns into {item:Shallow Water}.
Powder dropped on the ground does not count: you have to use it on the water.
Go back to {npc:Ghorza} and say {key:water}. She gives you a {item:Shaggy Ogre Bag}.
Help {npc:Ghorza} calm the spirits: prepare a shamanic rattle, bless three sacred sites, catch the totem hyaena and repair the village's protection runes.
Talk to {npc:Ghorza} and say {key:mission} (or {key:quest}) and {key:yes}. She gives you a {item:Gourd} and asks for {item:Shark Teeth} and 5 {item:Onyx Chip|Onyx Chips} to fill it.
With the diving gear, enter the water on the way to the Water Elementals. In the water there is a {item:Floating Green Flask (Quest)}: use it to get the {item:Shark Teeth}.
Kill ogres in Krailos until you have 5 {item:Onyx Chip|Onyx Chips} (they are loot from {creature:Ogre Brute|ogres}).

Use the {item:Shark Teeth} and then the {item:Onyx Chip|Onyx Chips} on the {item:Gourd}. You end up with a {item:Rattling Gourd} (*"You put the shark teeth into the hollowed gourd."* and *"You put the onyx chips into the hollowed gourd."*).
Go back to {npc:Ghorza} and say {key:mission}. Now you have to paint the rattle: she gives you a {item:Flask of Greasy Red Oil}.
Use any {item:Voodoo Lily} (for example at the marked spot) to get {item:Voodoo Lily Pollen} (*"You gather some blue-violet pollen from the voodoo lily."*).

Go to the {creature:Dragon|Dragons} area of Krailos and use a {item:Dragon's Nest (Hatched)|hatched dragon nest} to get {item:Dragon Egg Shells}. The nest is one floor above ground level, in the mountains south of the village; go back down the same way you came up.
There are {creature:Dragon|Dragons} and {creature:Dragon Hatchling|Dragon Hatchlings} around the nests.

Combine the {item:Voodoo Lily Pollen} with the {item:Dragon Egg Shells} to make {item:Grey-Blue Powder}. Use the powder on the {item:Flask of Greasy Red Oil} to get {item:Red Paint}. Finally, use the paint on the {item:Rattling Gourd}: you get a {item:Painted Gourd Rattle} (*"You paint the gourd with some weird ogre runes."*).
Go back to {npc:Ghorza} and say {key:mission}. She sends you to purify three ritual sites.

Walk **north** from Ghorza until you find three {item:Skull (Item)|skulls} in a semicircle. Stand on a tile **adjacent to all three at the same time** and use the {item:Painted Gourd Rattle}. If it is right, *"You're shaking the gourd rattle and bless the sacred site anew."* appears, along with red musical notes.
If *"It clatters, yet nothing else happens."* appears, you are in the wrong spot.
Bless site 2: the totem in the cactus forest
Go **east**, to the big forest of {item:Cactus Tree|cacti}. Stand next to the {item:Large Totem Pole (Banner)} and use the rattle.
Go **south** from Krailos Village until you find a large dragon ribcage. Walk into it and use the rattle inside.
Go back to {npc:Ghorza} and say {key:mission}. Her totem animal, a hyaena, has run away: she gives you a {item:Hyaena Trap}.

Go straight **west** from Ghorza (you should see the message *"It seems a hyaena has come along here lately. The tracks lead to a nearby sandhole."* a few times) until you find a {item:Pitfall|hole}. Go down it and use the {item:Hyaena Trap} on the {wiki:Sleeping Hyaena|Sleeping Hyaena} to get a {item:Trapped Hyaena}. Then climb back up with the {item:Rope} through the same hole.

Go back to {npc:Ghorza} and say {key:mission}. She gives you the stones to repair the protection runes: {item:Ogre Rune Stone}, {item:Ogre Rune Stones (Two)}, {item:Ogre Rune Stones (Corner)}, {item:Ogre Rune Stones (Up)} and {item:Ogre Rune Stones (Right)}.

The runes are to the north, east, south and west of the village (the west one needs two stones). **Use** each stone on the ground, on the marked empty space. If it is right, *"You put the ogre rune stones in the fitting place."* appears. The completed runes inside the village show what the final result looks like.
Go back to {npc:Ghorza} and say {key:mission}. You receive an {item:Onyx Pendant} and from now on you can buy potions and runes from her ({key:trade}).
Onyx Pendant + access to Ghorza's shop
The chief {npc:Vuzrog} is hungry. The meal can be repeated every 20 hours; after the **first** delivery he offers the mission The Thunder Tusk Clan **just once**.
Talk to {npc:Vuzrog}, in the middle of Krailos Village. Say {key:hi}, {key:quest} and {key:yes}. He wants roast meat, beer, cookies, cake and juice.
Gather everything listed in the table. Although Vuzrog asks for *prickly pear* juice, any kind of fruit will do.
Use {item:Raw Meat} (loot or {wiki:Skinning|skinning} of {creature:Clomp|Clomps}) on a {item:Campfire} to roast it
Inside a {item:Barrel (Quest)|barrel} southeast of the village ({coord:33684,31723,7})
Use a {item:Juice Squeezer} on 5 fruits with 5 empty {item:Vial|vials} in your backpack
Make a {item:Cake} (there is an {item:Oven|oven} next to Larek) and use a {item:Kitchen Knife} on a fruit with the cake in the same container
Go back to {npc:Vuzrog} and say {key:quest}, {key:yes} and {key:yes}. You receive 5 {item:Opal|Opals}.

Right after that, when he asks if you want to do something else, say {key:yes}. You have to kill **200** ogres of the Thunder Tusk clan: {creature:Ogre Brute|Ogre Brutes} and {creature:Ogre Savage|Ogre Savages} (combined).
This mission is only offered **once**, right after the first meal. {creature:Ogre Shaman|Ogre Shamans} do not count.

After the 200 kills go back to {npc:Vuzrog} and say {key:quest} and {key:yes}. You receive 10 Great Potions for your vocation ({item:Great Health Potion|Great Health Potions} for Knights, {item:Great Mana Potion|Great Mana Potions} for Mages, {item:Great Spirit Potion|Great Spirit Potions} for Paladins) and can now trade with {npc:Mugruu} (weapons, ammo and creature products).
Repeat the meal for the Ogre Chef

Every 20 hours you can bring the same meal to {npc:Vuzrog} again ({key:quest}, {key:yes}; after gathering the food {key:quest}, {key:yes}, {key:yes}). Each delivery is worth 5 {item:Opal|Opals}. On the **third** delivery you earn the **Ogre Chef** achievement.
5 Opals per delivery; Ogre Chef achievement after 3 deliveries
5. Survival of the Strongest (Grubokk) — do it before the goblin one
The ogre overseer {npc:Grubokk} wants to punish the slave goblins. You cannot have this mission and Revolt of the Goblins active at the same time: do this one **first**.

Go to the mountain range **south** of Krailos Village. Climb the stairs at the marked spot and follow the only path (several times up and down) until you reach {npc:Grubokk}. To return to the village, take the same path in reverse down to the stairs at {coord:33693,31775,7}.
Say {key:hi}, {key:quest}, {key:yes} and swear you will not help the goblins by saying {key:no help goblin}.
Use the {item:Draw Well|well} next to Grubokk to find the {item:Goblin Bone Key} ({item:Key 0555}) (*"You found a key made out of a goblin bone."*). It is needed to enter the {wiki:Krailos Mines}.

Go down the hole to the left of Grubokk. In the cave, walk **west** between the rocks to the gate at the marked spot and open it with the {item:Key 0555}. Go down, and down again by the ramp. Walk **northeast** and go down through the marked hole: you are in the mines.

To leave the mines, go back the same way: climb up through the holes with the {item:Rope}, go up the ramp and pass the gate to the cave below Grubokk; climb the hole next to him with the rope.
Hole to the lower floor of the mines

Use the {item:Dead Goblin (Fresh Quest)|Dead Goblins (Fresh Quest)} and {item:Dead Goblin (Decaying Quest)|Dead Goblins (Decaying Quest)} in the mines and surroundings until you find a {item:Heavy Stone Hammer} (*"You found a heavy ogre hammer. This might come in handy."*).
There are many {creature:Goblin|goblins} near {npc:An Imprisoned Goblin}.

Use the hammer on the {item:Crude Water Conveyor|Crude Water Conveyors} (*"You sabotage the wheel. It stops turning."*). Only **6** are accessible, so you have to use some of them more than once, waiting **3 minutes** between uses of the same wheel (if it is too early: *"This wheel is already dented as if sabotaged."*). After 10, *"That's all the wheels you needed to sabotage."* appears.
Go back to {npc:Grubokk}, say {key:quest} and then {key:sabotage}. He tells you to poison the goblins' wells with salt crystals.

Take the {item:Heavy Stone Hammer} to the large dry lake **east** of Krailos Village. Use the hammer on the {item:Crystallized Salt} to get {item:Poison Salt Crystal}. If you miss, *"That was a weak blow. Try harder."* appears; if you hit, *"You pound a piece of salt crystal from the solid ground."*. Do this on **two** different salt deposits: on the second one the hammer breaks (*"The hammer breaks with the blow. You gather some salt crystal. This should be enough."*).
If *"You already took all the useful crystal splinters from this one. Try another."* appears, switch to another salt deposit.

Climb the mountains near Grubokk and use the crystals on the two {item:Draw Well|wells} (*"You dump the poison salt into the water well."*; on the second one *"Acrid fumes waft up. Seems your job is done here."* also appears). Then go back down the same way to {npc:Grubokk}.
Go back to {npc:Grubokk}, say {key:quest} and {key:poison}. Last task: flood the tunnels by sabotaging three treadmills.

Keep using the dead goblins ({item:Dead Goblin (Fresh Quest)|Fresh} and {item:Dead Goblin (Decaying Quest)|Decaying}) in the mines until you find {item:Large Pliers} (*"You found a pair of ogre pliers. This might come in handy."*).

Use the pliers on the three {item:Crude Treadmill|Crude Treadmills}. Each one turns into a {item:Wooden Treadmill (Krailos)|Wooden Treadmill} and the water starts filling the mines. On the third one the pliers break (*"[...] Now get out quick before you drown, too!"*).
After you sabotage them, the mines flood: get out quickly or you will drown.
Leave and wait for the message

Leave the mines (just getting close to Grubokk is enough) and wait a few minutes until *"That was fast. You got out just in time before the water flooded everything."* appears. You are teleported to the entrance.
**Do not** talk to Grubokk before you receive this message.
Talk to {npc:Grubokk}, say {key:quest} and {key:flood}. You receive 5 {item:Opal|Opals} and 2 {item:Flask of Rust Remover|Flasks of Rust Remover}. You can help him again after 20 hours.
Now help the goblins revolt against the ogres. You cannot have this mission and Survival of the Strongest active at the same time.
Talk to {npc:Nibble} in Krailos Village. Say {key:hi}, {key:quest} (or {key:mission}) and {key:yes}. He wants 20 Holy Bog Frogs for the goblins imprisoned in the mines.
Go to the Greasy Stones cave

Bring an {item:Obsidian Knife}. Go to {npc:Grubokk} (stairs at {coord:33693,31775,7}) and, if you do not have it yet, take the {item:Key 0555} from the well next to him. Go down the hole and climb up with the rope at the first marked spot. Climb up another rope, walk **west** and go down another hole. Open the gate with the key.

In the cave there are {item:Greasy Stone (Inhabited)|Greasy Stones}. Use them: each one becomes a {item:Greasy Stone (Uninhabited)} and spawns a {creature:Bug}, a {creature:Centipede} or a {creature:Holy Bog Frog} (*"You found a holy bog frog."*). Use the {item:Obsidian Knife} on the frogs that are **still alive** to get {item:Dead Holy Bog Frog|Dead Holy Bog Frogs}. You need **20**.

To leave the cave, go back the same way: pass the gate ({coord:33626,31797,6}), climb up the hole with the {item:Rope}, go back **east**, go down both rope spots you climbed up and climb up the hole next to Grubokk with the {item:Rope}.
There are 31 stones in total and they become inhabited again 5 minutes later. If you cannot get 20 at once, wait and use them again.

Go back to the cave on the left, under the hole next to Grubokk. Walk **west** between the rocks to the gate and open it with the {item:Key 0555}. Go down, and down again by the ramp. Walk **northeast** and go down the hole. Keep going **northeast** until you reach {npc:An Imprisoned Goblin}.
Say {key:hi}, {key:quest} (or {key:Frog God}) and {key:yes} to hand in the 20 {item:Dead Holy Bog Frog|Dead Holy Bog Frogs}.
Say {key:quest} and {key:yes}. The goblin gives you a random password: **Swordfish**, **Sugatrap** or **Hopgoblin**. Make a note of it!
If you get it wrong or forget the password, come back here and say {key:new password} and {key:yes}.

Leave the mines and go to {npc:A Goblin Exile}, near the marked spot (the NPC is one floor below, see his position on the map). Say {key:hi} and then your password.

To leave the mines, take the entry path in reverse (hole with {item:Rope}, ramp, gate and hole next to Grubokk) and come down from the mountains by the stairs at {coord:33693,31775,7}. {npc:A Goblin Exile} is **one floor below** ({coord:33736,31732,8}): go down the {item:Pitfall|hole} in that area and, at the end, climb back up with the {item:Rope}.
Wrong password: *"No! You lie! That not true."* Ask {npc:An Imprisoned Goblin} for a new one ({key:new password}).
Open the right door and pick up the weapon
After saying the password you can open one of the {item:Sealed Door|sealed doors} next to the goblin. Choose the one that matches your password:
Hand in the weapon to A Runaway Goblin

Take the weapon to {npc:A Runaway Goblin}, near the marked spot (the NPC is one floor below). Say {key:hi}, your password and {key:yes}. He is also **one floor below** ({coord:33523,31669,8}): go down the {item:Pitfall|hole} in that area and climb back up with the {item:Rope}. Then return to the mines by the path from the previous step.
Go back to {npc:An Imprisoned Goblin} and say {key:quest}. Now you have to **repair** 10 water wheels.

Use the dead goblins in the mines until you find {item:Large Pliers}. Use them on 10 {item:Crude Water Conveyor|Crude Water Conveyors} (*"You fixed the conveyor wheel. It should pump water now."*). The accessible wheels are the same as in Grubokk's mission (see the table in section 5). After 10 the pliers break (*"You fixed enough ten wheels just as the pliers break."*).

Go back to {npc:An Imprisoned Goblin} and say {key:quest}. You receive 5 {item:Onyx Chip|Onyx Chips}, a {item:Slightly Rusted Helmet} and a {item:Slightly Rusted Shield}. The goblin missions can be repeated every 20 hours.

When you have all **seven** missions completed in the quest log at the same time — Hungry New World, Quenching the Thirst, Survival of the Strongest, Revolt of the Goblins, The Chieftain's Menu, The Great Hunger and The Thunder Tusk Clan — you earn the **The Call of the Wild** achievement.
Grubokk's missions, the goblins' missions and Vuzrog's meal can be repeated every 20 hours.
The mission The Thunder Tusk Clan can only be done once (it is only offered after Vuzrog's first meal).
Ghorza's salt lake alternates between dry and full: if it is full when you want to start Quenching the Thirst, wait a few days.
